description:
[Guides] One blog post: text, headings, FAQ and related posts. A published post as plain text for reading or quoting: `title`, `url`, `summary`, `author`, `tags`,
`published`/`updated` (UTC), `headings` (its h2/h3 outline), `text` (the body without HTML, cut at 20,000
characters - `text_truncated` says so), `faq` (question/answer pairs the post carries) and `related` posts.
Cite and link the `url`. From the blog's own per-post cache. Full text of one blog guide for answering from it; cite and link the url.

slug.description: The post's slug (from `/guides` or the end of its blog URL).
